scope: Source/data inspection, one new adapter, AST parsing and arithmetic on existing literal records. No production edits, constructors, residuals, equilibrium, eigenanalysis or tests executed by this reviewer.

selection.rejected: Simply admitting endpoint contact in GroundPlane
selection.reason: Coupled finite-difference geometry probes can move a clamped endpoint through the wall before its constraint is satisfied; Newton also permits roundoff root violations. No guard bypass, tolerance exemption, epsilon displacement, or constraint elimination is introduced.
selection.selected: Explicit complete reflected single physical lifting beam with central full clamp; no aerodynamic image flag.
selection.status: Ideal slip-wall reconstruction, to be checked by independent exact-sample half-image/full-field tests and resulting static mirror symmetry. It is not a simulation of every tunnel wall, spacer, viscous boundary layer or mounting detail.

theory.source: Drela steady theory section4.5, printed pp34-36, equations165-175; pinned asw_theory.txt1733-1798
equations: The explicit negative-side beam traverses from negative tip toward root. Reversing the reflected horseshoe endpoints changes its oriented vortex sign, yielding the same image field with an even physical Gamma distribution.
For span-tangent inflow beta=0, reflection leaves the freestream invariant; the symmetric full field has zero wall-normal velocity.
theory.guide: aswing_doc.txt2634-2672 describes G as image selection, says the Earth-origin plane normal is prescribed, and requires all aircraft geometry above it. Contact is not explicitly approved by that guide.
limitations: No claim that the historical ASWING implementation accepted contact in the same way.
No automatic even material mirror: torsion/bending terms need the parity derived below.
A second unrelated physical beam would receive cross-physical core regularization; one continuous physical beam preserves same-physical zero-core interactions.

Half/full mesh endpoints alone do not imply equal aerodynamic samples: Glauert receiver coordinates depend on the whole beam domain. Independent equivalence must split the actual full mesh at zero and retain exactly its right-side receiver/endpoint/material samples.
The full construction is a symmetric equilibrium representation. It does not establish stability against antisymmetric disturbances or the historical transient/fluctuation branch.

material_reflection.axes: Both sides use increasing global parameter t along +y, chord +x and normal +z. The negative side is the reflected positive material with reversed longitudinal parameter.
equations: R_minus(-s)=S*R_plus(s)*D; this is a proper triad even though S,D individually have determinant -1.
Virtual spatial rotation theta_minus=-S*theta_plus; coordinate derivative reversal gives material curvature parity diag(1,-1,1) in [kappa_c,kappa_s,kappa_n].
In primary/native reduced order [eps_s,kappa_s,kappa_c,kappa_n], strain_minus=P*strain_plus, P=diag(1,-1,1,1). K_minus=P*K_plus*P preserves strain energy.
Oriented cut force N_minus=-S*N_plus and cut moment M_minus=S*M_plus.
Mass centroid p_minus=S*p_plus; physical inertia J_minus=S*J_plus*S^T.
material_reflection.offsets: Nta/Cta and other c/n offsets are even: reflection/reparameterization preserves the material c,n cross-section coordinates.
material_reflection.inertia: Physical Ixy/Iyz reverse sign; Ixz and diagonal entries retain sign. Encode ASW signed products only after physical reflection. Keep both root-attached lumped masses, whose centroids lie on opposite sides.
material_reflection.projection: Reuse accepted pazy_primary_conm2.source and pazy_primary.projection; remove only original K12 as already disclosed, then apply parity. No coefficient fit.

original_point_masses.note: A root attachment lies on the wall but its actual point-mass centroid has y=0.00644284658m, hence is above the plane.

full.note: All 15 section intervals and16 original mass stations per half retained. Both meshes contain the same central root and all source stations. Exact current source span is not stretched to nominal0.55m.

geometry.payload: Additional10g Test2 mass per half at TE x=.0559,y=+-actual_semispan; Avin §V/§V.B supports TE, while Riso §IV.C says10mm aft. Zero-gravity stationary force is independent of this disagreement. No modal/time claim.

condition.qualification: Mixed-source comparison: corrected primary structural properties with literal ISAE section slope/bounds and density. Incompressible Mach0 is explicit, not inferred exact tunnel atmosphere. Preserve positive modelg9.81 solely for Weight-to-mass conversion.

primary_sources.title: Avin et al author paper, DOI10.2514/1.J060621
primary_sources.relevance: Floor mounting with20mm spacer and additional10g atTE. Exact root-plane ideal wall omits the spacer/rootgap, other tunnel boundaries and viscous effects.

observables.positions: Positive-tip material LE=r+Q*(-.0441,0,0), TE=r+Q*(.0559,0,0); mid=(LE+TE)/2. Q is deformation rotation for the straight reference chord/span triad.
observables.baseline: Subtract each mesh own zero-flow baseline; source missing zero-speed experimental entries remain missing. One baseline suffices for the flat-jig, zero-gravity computational geometry shared by all prescribed inflow angles.
observables.twist: theta=atan2(z_LE-z_TE,x_TE-x_LE), positive for LE aboveTE in downstream-positive x; subtract baseline. This reuses accepted primary structural recovery. Avin written x convention must not be copied without its axis orientation.
observables.coordinate_caveat: Pinned README says vertical and differentialLE/TE but does not explicitly bind experimental output axes to root or tunnel. Riso Bx downstream suggests wind-normal modeled outputs; it does not prove experimental preprocessing.
retained_projections: Retain all three baseline-subtracted midchord components and both LE/TE vectors; label both comparisons. No hidden replacement of the measured axis.
observables.twist_invariance: A common rotation about span changes absolute projected chord angle by a constant, so baseline-subtracted projected twist is invariant on the same atan2 branch; it is not automatically identical to an arbitrary Euler component after finite bend.
